items.item: Main-window engine decided: Servo 0.7 (D2)
items.evidence: Owner, 2026-10-22: "We should upgrade to servo 7. Use servo"

items.item: New GPUI app in desktop/ on GPUI Kit 0.8 (gpui-pre 0.3.9) embedding Servo 0.7.0 opens a window; links no Theorem GPUI crates (D1, Scope)
Depend on Theorem's Servo 0.7 fork (git rev b9d6db9e, features webcrypto, webgl, brotli-compression-stream), lock seeded from Theorem apps/browser, one toolchain (1.97.1) for Servo and gpui-pre
items.evidence: desktop/Cargo.toml pins the fork rev; cargo resolves after carrying zed-font-kit with freetype-sys 0.23 (desktop/vendor/zed-font-kit/THEOREM-PATCH.md). First full build pending.

items.item: Servo renders through WindowRenderingContext in a child NSView of the GPUI window; frame-ready paints and presents; size and HiDPI scale follow the window (D2 step 1)
Servo's config_dir in app data; localStorage layout survives relaunch (D2, D4)
items.evidence: After relaunch the dock layout comes back from localStorage (docs/desktop/conformance.md, Chat).

items.item: GPUI mouse, wheel and key events forwarded as Servo input events; unhandled keys reach app shortcuts; cursor and focus follow the page (D2)
items.evidence: Clicks, drags, wheel, keys and shortcut replay checked through the THEOREM_DRIVE driver, which skips AppKit hit testing (docs/desktop/conformance.md).

items.item: GPUI input handler over Servo's input-method control; composition and dismissal reach Crepe (D2)
items.evidence: Composition events reach Servo, but Servo inserts committed text only into input and textarea, so Crepe gets none (docs/desktop/conformance.md, gap 6).

items.item: ClipboardDelegate over GPUI's clipboard; Edit menu sends Servo editing actions (D2)
items.evidence: Cmd-C reaches the system clipboard (pbpaste) and Cmd-V pastes once after the replay fix in page.rs (docs/desktop/conformance.md, fix B).

items.item: select, color picker, file picker, alert/confirm/prompt and context menu drawn with GPUI Kit in popup windows or dialogs; window.open goes to the system browser (D2)
Servo's AccessKit tree forwarded to an AccessKit macOS adapter; VoiceOver reads the transcript and composer (D2, Phase 1)
Host starts .output/server/index.mjs with a bundled Bun on 127.0.0.1 at a stable stored port; restarts it on exit, stops it on quit; host and server talk over a stdin/stdout JSON control channel (D4)
Launch secret over stdin swapped for an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie; cookie and exact Host header required; a page in another browser cannot reach the server (D4)
Servo request_navigation keeps the top frame on the app origin and iframes on the app origin or the block listener; other links open in the system browser (D4)

Conformance pass in Servo 0.7 against Chrome: chat stream, run resume, approval, artifact and pinned revision, thread switch, layout restored after relaunch, React Flow, Crepe (IME, selection, clipboard, / menu), Dockview, Mermaid, Shiki; each gap given a disposition: Theorem UI, Servo, or host (Phase 0)
items.evidence: docs/desktop/conformance.md: Servo against Chrome per component, with a CSSOM diff and a disposition for each gap. Approving a tool was not exercised: no reachable tool asks for approval.

items.item: In-scene spike: Servo IOSurface frames painted with gpui::surface() through a BGRA path patched into gpui-pre-apple's Metal renderer; a GPUI overlay above the page in the same window; frame times compared with the child view (D2 step 2, Phase 0)
Main window on the in-scene renderer once the spike passes; BGRA renderer patch carried by the app through [patch.crates-io], not offered upstream (D2, Phase 1)

Bridge relayed by the local server: JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST /desktop/host/rpc, passed to the host over the control channel; host events over SSE at /desktop/host/events; types generated with ts-rs; src/lib/desktop/host.ts absent on the web (D5)
Server accepts bridge requests only with the session cookie and the app Origin; an opaque-origin block iframe and a page in another browser are refused (D5)
pickFolder and openNativeEditor end to end: a GPUI Kit editor window saves a file and the page updates through the watcher (D6, Phase 0)
Page calls Theorem through TheoremClient against the local server's proxy; client.ts and theorem-proxy.ts unchanged; token never in page JavaScript (D3)

OAuth PKCE (oauth4webapi) run by the local server with the system browser and a loopback redirect; Keychain only in the host; refresh token passed and rotated over stdin; static token from .env for development (D3)
Signed Theorem.app and .dmg from cargo-packager with the host (Servo linked in), re-signed Bun runtime and .output; runs on a clean machine; menu bar, shortcuts and deep links (D4, Phase 1)
Web deployment still works and never exposes workspace or bridge routes (D4, Phase 1)
Any folder opens through the native picker; desktop-only routes serve only folders the person opened (D16)
@parcel/watcher records external edits as reconcile revisions; atomic write then rename; own writes skipped by content hash (D7)
Ids in .theorem/ids.json; renames keep ids; theorem-id frontmatter honored; Spaces place { kind: workspace-file, id } (D8)
Wikilinks, heading links, block links and embeds resolve; backlinks listed; links rewrite on rename (D8, D16)
Rebuildable index (links, backlinks, tags, properties, headings, tasks, FTS5 search) in bun:sqlite in app data (Data ownership)
.theorem/ holds only user config; index, compile cache, last-run values and Loro docs live in app data keyed by workspace id (D8)
Tags, frontmatter properties, daily notes from a template, attachments folder and canvases work as Obsidian users expect; no .obsidian config or plugins (D16)
File tree for the workspace (Phase 2)
File-handler registry with match, Panel (Dockview), Card and optional create; third-party handlers load through the block sandbox (D13)
Built-in handlers: md, canvas, executable graph, js/ts/tsx/py, tsx app and html, csv/json, pdf, image/audio/video, unknown; each opens in a panel and as a card (D13)
.canvas files in JSON Canvas 1.0 on React Flow with theorem: namespaced scalar keys; round-trip unchanged; project Space exports to .canvas (D15)
Crepe live-block node ($node + $view via @prosemirror-adapter/react, parser priority above code_block) round-trips the fence byte for byte (D9)
![[tool file]] embeds render the tool live and survive renames (D9)
Brace-attribute .live fences with #id; plain fences stay inert; query and agent fences render (D9)
Observable notebook-kit and runtime recompute only downstream pure blocks; effectful blocks run only on explicit trigger (D9)
Sucrase worker compile; vendored import map with integrity; SHA-256 compile cache; esbuild-wasm only for standalone export (D9)
Each block in an opaque-origin sandbox=allow-scripts iframe from a second loopback listener with a strict CSP; separate block subdomain on the web (D9)
MessageChannel bridge serves only declared capabilities; undeclared calls and non-clonable values are refused (D9)
Untrusted folders show tool source and do not execute until trusted (D9)
Per-workspace Loro state document shared across blocks, persisted by the workspace service, following the sync policy (D9)
Last-run values shown beside code; optional pinned output between theorem:output markers (D9, D13)
Formulas in QuickJS (quickjs-emscripten worker), mentions, views bound to a subtree and inherited properties (D9, Phase 4)
Explicit-trigger runs are harness runs recording source revision, dependency revisions, inputs digest, status and outputs; they outlive the view (D10)
Synced workspaces run remotely through codemode-kernel; LocalOnly workspaces run in a host-side local runner confined to the folder (sandbox library from the sourcing gate) (D10)
Run outputs written as workspace files and referenced by hash; artifact store for binaries (D10)
Executable .canvas graphs run pure nodes reactively and effectful nodes as runs (D14)
Agent/Journal/<date>.md projection with run markers; text outside markers survives regeneration (D11)
journal_append op in the Solo regime; namespace.rs assertion updated for that one op (D11)
TypeScript sync shared by the desktop server and web deployment: per-file Loro docs over Documents v2 (canonical Loro body, markdownProjection = bytes) plus a directory document (D12)
Each workspace has a replication policy (LocalOnly, Synced, ConnectedLive); E2EE implications documented (D12)
Phone runs the web deployment as an installed web app: OPFS copy, offline service worker, Crepe editing, pure live blocks run, effectful blocks trigger remote runs (D12)
Phone keeps pinned folders and recent files local; other entries download on open; offline edits merge on reconnect (D12)
Co-browsing window: a second Servo web view on the same instance that Theorem drives (input, screenshots, script, request observation); agent and person browse the same page (D6, Phase 8)
Theorem backend: workspace document kinds, revision authorship, artifact store, journal_append, run record fields, OAuth project scope (Backend changes)

SDK surfaces for documents and sync, runs and artifacts, journals; tool-author surface with generated declarations and handler registration; a third-party handler and tool load from the public surface (D17)
Today.md with a live fence and an embedded tool; agent run writes a result file and a journal entry; all open offline on the phone and the tool runs (First end-to-end target)
